action_items: (Doc/low) README/review-request bullet says 'MP-6/IR-3/PS-3 signed' on seeded LTP attestations – confirmed in app/seed_phase3.py; works on a fresh seed. The live preview DB had been mutated by prior test iterations (demo-expire cascade had back-dated IR-3), so a clean reproduction requires POST /api/v1/admin/demo/reset first. Agent suite calls reset implicitly via platform admin before running; manual verification should do the same.

(Hygiene/low) /api/v1/admin/demo/reset does NOT remove previously-invited user accounts (test_invitee_*@aegisrmf.demo keep appearing in the login dev-user picker across iterations – 4 visible at time of this run). If reset is intended to be the single source of truth for a 'clean' demo, extend it to delete non-seed users; otherwise document the carve-out.
(Doc/nit) Previously-noted (iteration_2) Recharts width(-1) warning on Portfolio trend chart still present but out of Phase 3 scope.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/app/api/v1/phase3.py – inheritance endpoint computes 'sum_check' from fully_inherited+shared+system == assigned which is a nice invariant guard and surfaces as inh-card-sum in UI. Good.

backend/app/api/v1/phase3.py:authorization_decision correctly audits 'authz.denied' via audit.record_now (bypassing commit) before raising 403, so the denial is persisted even when the request is rejected – matches the acceptance criterion that 'ISSO POST authorization-decision returns 403 and audit log has authz.denied'.

backend/app/api/v1/phase3.py:policy_finding_action dismiss path enforces len(justification.strip()) >= 10 at 422 – exactly as the UI expects; the justification is stored and surfaces on the finding row.
backend/app/api/v1/phase3.py:assess – evidence_ids are filtered through wf.evidence_in_system() so cross-system evidence linking is impossible; good defense-in-depth.
backend/app/api/v1/phase3.py:edit_rule enforces last step action=='decide' and known roles – good validation; version increments monotonically and old rule is deactivated atomically.

backend/app/api/v1/phase3.py:invite returns 'temporary_password' only once, hashes via bcrypt (hash_password) – correct dev-only pattern. BUT invited users (test_invitee_*) accumulate across resets/iterations and surface on the public /login dev-picker – consider either (a) opting invited users out of the dev-picker, or (b) deleting them in /admin/demo/reset.
backend/app/api/v1/phase3.py:_policy_out and audit_log both correctly exclude heavy fields; policy text_content stripped from policy list for payload size.
frontend/src/pages/Phase3Pages.tsx & Phase3Extras.tsx – data-testid coverage is excellent (every actionable element has one). No fake/no-op buttons found on the pages that were exercised.
Known from iteration_2 but still present: Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings on leadership trend chart (cosmetic, out of Phase 3 scope).

rca of the issue: No functional defects found in Phase 3. The only quality nit is state pollution across test iterations: /admin/demo/reset preserves invited (non-seed) users, so test_invitee_*@aegisrmf.demo accounts accumulate on the dev-login picker. Mitigation: either (a) extend the reset endpoint to purge invitees along with their auth_identities and role_assignments, or (b) have the dev picker filter to seeded accounts only.
